description: Ensure a default federated query routes to `web-search.learnings` and surfaces internalized findings without firing any live web request; live web joins only on explicit request or fallback escalation when project results are empty or weak.

requirements.description: Default federated queries must route exclusively to web-search.learnings (SCOPE_PROJECT) and must not issue any HTTP requests to SearXNG or external engines. The live-web provider (web-search.live) joins the federated set only when: (a) the query includes an explicit --type web or --all flag, or (b) fallback escalation is triggered because project-scoped results are empty or scored below the configured weakness threshold. Fallback escalation must be logged and the escalation reason surfaced in the result envelope.
requirements.title: Scope-Aware Federated Query Routing — Learnings-First, Live-Web Gated

validation.notes: Routing decision function returns [web-search.learnings] for a default query with no flags set
Routing decision function returns [web-search.learnings, web-search.live] when --type web flag is present
Routing decision function returns [web-search.learnings, web-search.live] when --all flag is present
Fallback escalation trigger fires when learnings result set is empty (zero hits)
Fallback escalation trigger fires when all learnings hits score below the configured weakness threshold
Escalation reason field is populated in the result envelope when fallback occurs
A default federated query against a populated learnings store issues exactly zero HTTP calls to SearXNG (HTTP mock asserts zero external calls)

A default federated query against an empty learnings store triggers fallback escalation and subsequently queries SearXNG (HTTP mock asserts exactly one SearXNG call with escalation reason in response)
Default federated query served entirely from learnings completes with zero external HTTP calls and within 500ms at p95
Standard developer queries against internalized research findings do not consume any live-web rate-limit budget
Fallback escalation to live web is observable in logs and result metadata for audit purposes

title: Scope-Aware Federated Blending
